name: LemurSaucePacket
description: A Create-powered SMP that still feels like Minecraft. Build factories, rail networks and airships, explore a reworked world, and fight your way up the ages.

news.title: Land claims are gone
news.body: Open Parties and Claims and Aeroclaims have been removed: no more chunk claims, so pick your spot with care and keep valuables close. The ESC menu's Claims button is now Waypoints, and Skills opens the skills panel in your inventory.

news.title: A new look, one kit everywhere
news.body: The ESC menu is now a riveted board: Map, Quests, Missions and Waypoints on the left, your character with Skills, Backpack, Team and Voice on the right, and every usual button in the middle. Brass buttons and iron plates run through every screen, the quest book and the skills screen, with icons painted in the same style. The launcher got the same treatment. Press ESC in-game and have a look.

news.title: Welcome to LemurSaucePacket
news.body: Press Play. The launcher installs Minecraft, NeoForge and every mod for you, keeps them in sync with the server, and drops you straight in.
